name: Microsoft Entra Device Groups Sync
description: Sync Microsoft Entra device group membership and ownership data into Action1 endpoint custom attributes.

actions.label: List Entra Org Mappings
actions.description: Loads Action1 organization mappings for the configured Microsoft Entra tenant.

actions.label: Save Entra Org Mapping
actions.description: Creates or updates an Action1 organization mapping row for the configured Microsoft Entra tenant.

actions.label: Delete Entra Org Mapping
actions.description: Deletes an Action1 organization mapping row for the configured Microsoft Entra tenant.

actions.label: Discover Action1 Mapping Options
actions.description: Loads read-only Action1 organization options for the Mapping screen.

actions.label: Run Entra Sync
actions.description: Runs the Marketplace-tracked Microsoft Entra device groups synchronization workflow.
